name: com.pulsemcp/x-twitter
description: MCP server for X (Twitter): home timeline, user tweet history, bookmarks, recent search, and tweet/user lookups via OAuth 2.0 user context, plus private bookmark add/remove. Never posts, replies, likes, retweets, follows, or performs any public action.

environmentVariables.name: X_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (confidential client) from the X developer portal. Required for refresh-token mode.

environmentVariables.name: X_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret. Required for refresh-token mode.

environmentVariables.name: X_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token minted via the one-time `oauth-setup` consent flow. Required for refresh-token mode. X rotates this on every refresh.

environmentVariables.name: X_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A short-lived OAuth 2.0 user-context access token injected by a central refresher. Use this instead of the refresh-token trio for centrally-managed deployments; the server will not refresh it itself.

environmentVariables.name: X_TWITTER_ENABLED_TOOLGROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool groups to expose: 'readonly' (reads only) and/or 'readwrite' (reads plus private bookmark add/remove). Defaults to all groups when unset.
